To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

serum after autologous stem cell transplantation (SCT) stimulates proliferation, maintains the primitive phenotype and expands the number of human hematopoietic progenitor cells (CD34+,CD133+,CD45−) in vitro.
serum taken from patients after autologous stem cell transplantation significantly stimulates proliferation and expansion of human hematopoietic progenitor cells.

hematopoietic progenitor cells (CD34+) are activated in vivo after autologous hematopoietic transplantation and this is reflected by an increase of the number of colony forming units (colony-forming unit-granulocyte-macrophage; CFU-GM) and cobblestone area forming cells (cobblestone area-formng cell; CAFC).
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of novel therapeutic strategies for the treatment of hematological diseases.

the development of novel approaches to improve stem cell mobilization, engraftment and expansion after HSCT, which are important for successful treatment of patients suffering from hematologic malignancies.
the question how hematopoietic progenitor cells are stimulated after autologous transplantation.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the serum after autologous transplantation stimulates proliferation and expansion of human HPC.
the serum of patients with autologous HS transplantation is capable of stimulating proliferation and expansion of human hematopoietic progenitor cells.
the hematopoietic progenitors are stimulated by the serum after HSCT, which is a result of the increased expression of the growth factors.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
serum from patients after autologous transplantation is a powerful stimulator for proliferation of HPC.
hematopoietic progenitors are not only activated by cytokines, but also by systemically released factors, like PDGF, that are produced by the damaged tissue.
the hematopoietic system can be stimulated to produce growth factors that can be used to stimulate the stem cell pool and thereby increase hematopoietic reconstitution after HSCT.
The main takeaway from our work is that
serum after autologous transplantation stimulates the proliferation and expansion of hematopoietics progenitor cells.
the hematopoietic progenitor cell compartment is stimulated by systemically released factors after HSCT.
the serum of patients after autologous hematopoietic cell transplantation stimulates the proliferation of hematopoietics stem cells.
